fields.title: 📖 Follow the Scharīʿah, not the desires
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah set the Prophet ﷺ upon a Scharīʿah of the command and commanded him to follow it and not the desires of those who do not know.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The contrast is clear: Scharīʿah or Hawā. Whoever replaces Allah’s way does not merely follow an opinion, but leaves the revealed standard.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Ǧāthiyah 45:18.
